channel.title: Adnan Harun Doğan - Blog
channel.description: Adnan Harun Doğan - Graduate Research & Teaching Assistant at Middle East Technical University. Research in differentiable optimization and deep learning for computer vision.

item.title: Frequency-Weighted Neural Kalman Filters
item.description: Learned frequency-weighted Kalman filters that denoise the innovation spectrum under spectral supervision. IEEE/ICRA 2026.

item.title: paper-reproductions
item.description: A monorepo of from-scratch PyTorch reproductions of machine learning papers.

item.title: Offline and Model-Based RL: CQL, Decision Transformer, DPO, and World Models
item.description: Conservative Q-learning, the decision transformer, direct preference optimization, and world-model agents.

item.title: Actor-Critic and Distributed RL: DDPG, TD3, SAC, and Beyond
item.description: Deep deterministic policy gradients, twin delayed DDPG, soft actor-critic, and distributed reinforcement learning.

item.title: Sparse Inertial Motion Capture: IMU Models, Orientation, and Sensor Fusion
item.description: IMU measurement models, orientation estimation, sparse sensor configurations, and coordinate-frame handling.

item.title: Trust-Region Policy Methods: TRPO, PPO, and GRPO
item.description: Trust region policy optimization, proximal policy optimization, group relative policy optimization, and why implementation details matter.

item.title: torchestrator
item.description: A Dockerfile-like declarative runner for PyTorch training pipelines: torchfile DSL, registry roster, content-addressed run hub.

item.description: The policy gradient theorem, REINFORCE, baseline subtraction and advantage functions, and generalized advantage estimation.

item.title: Uncertainty Quantification: Predictive Variance, MC Dropout, and Deep Ensembles
item.description: The predictive variance decomposition, heteroscedastic heads with MC dropout, prior networks, and deep ensembles.

item.title: Posterior Approximation: Variational Inference from Mean-Field to Cold Posteriors
item.description: Variational inference and the ELBO, stochastic VI, mean-field Gaussian BNNs, tight bounds, and the cold posterior effect.

item.title: Bayesian Neural Networks: Evidence, HMC, and Function-Space Bayes
item.description: The Bayesian program for neural networks, evidence and Occam factors, HMC, the NNGP limit, and mode-averaging ensembles.

item.title: The Neural Tangent Kernel and Infinite-Width Networks

item.title: Differentiating Through Constrained Optimization: Implicit Layers and Convex Programs
item.description: Implicit differentiation of optimality conditions, perturbation methods, differentiable convex layers, and input convex networks.

item.title: PAC-Bayes Generalization Bounds: From McAllester to Nonvacuous Bounds
item.description: The McAllester bound, deterministic versus stochastic classifiers, refinements, and nonvacuous bounds for deep networks.

item.title: Vision Transformers: ViT, Self-Attention, and the CNN Comparison

item.title: Variational Autoencoders: The ELBO and the Reparameterization Trick

item.title: Classical Statistical Learning: ERM, Capacity Control, and Uniform Convergence
item.description: Empirical risk minimization, maximum likelihood as M-estimation, capacity control, and the classical uniform-convergence toolkit.

item.description: Observable/Eventful event model with topic-keyed message queues, competing consumers, and queue-RPC.
